intro: Acting on orders funneled through Neeru Fireblade, Ak'Zeloth charges Horde travelers with neutralizing the Demon Seed atop Dreadmist Peak. By deploying an unstable Flawed Power Stone upon an altar of fire, adventurers shatter a potent conduit tied to the Burning Legion before its dark influence spreads further across the Barrens.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Demon Seed is a powerful tool for the Burning Legion. It rests in a cave on Dreadmist Peak, above a demonic altar of fire.
I have prepared power stones that when placed near the Seed will disrupt its connection to the Legion.

Take a stone from the table and bring it to the altar of fire atop Dreadmist Peak. Travel west, then north when the road forks. The Peak will be to your left. The safest climb to the top is on its northern face.
And hurry—the stone's power will consume itself in time.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Demon Seed still exists. I can sense its power...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your task is complete. You have destroyed the Demon Seed as Neeru bid. But this is not the end...

The destruction of the Demon Seed sent waves of power through the ether, waves of staggering force. I felt them, and I am sure other beings did as well. Others who will wonder why their toy was broken...
But regardless of future troubles, I have something for you. Neeru sent it as payment. And he bid me thank you.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
